How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
menu
Caring for Eternity® flowers is remarkably simple because they require no water or maintenance. To keep them looking their best, keep them in a room-temperature environment away from direct sunlight, leave them secure in their box or vessel, and avoid placing anything on top of the blooms. If dust collects over time, gently remove it with a soft duster.
